$comment: Per-commit review (agent/plans/PLAN-per-commit-review.md, approved by the operator ruling of 2026-10-02 that replaced the PR-level Claude review). Read by .claude/hooks/stop/wl_review.py, the post-bash trigger .claude/hooks/post-bash/review_commit.py and the push guard block_push_with_unrecorded_reviews.py. Every knob lives here and not in an environment variable, so the threshold can be raised with a one-line diff and no code change.
$model: The dated haiku build the Stop-hook judge already pins (wl_judge.JUDGE_MODEL). Operator ruling 2026-10-02: the reviewer is haiku.
$budget_usd: Per call. A measured warm haiku call with this schema costs about $0.02; the cap is a post-hoc stop, so it sits well clear of the real cost.
$measured: Live smoke 2026-10-02T07:45Z (PLAN-per-commit-review T13), the post-bash member driven by a recorded PostToolUse event on a scratch commit that planted a values[1:] bug: the hook returned in 0.06s, one haiku call took 18.3s and cost $0.029, the file landed 19.1s after the commit with that bug as its one [high] finding, and the next Bash call surfaced it.
$timeout_s: One model call, killed as a process group through wl_proc.run.
$max_concurrent: Reviewers allowed to call the model at once; the rest wait for a slot.
$slot_wait_s: How long a queued reviewer waits for a slot before writing Verdict: failed (queue timeout).
$max_spawn_per_trigger: Uncovered commits one post-bash trigger may start reviewers for; the rest are named by the push guard with their --review-run command.
$max_uncovered_scan: Newest commits of the branch range the coverage walk looks at.
$diff_cap_bytes: Diff bytes sent to the model. Files cut by the cap are listed under Unreviewed:.
$block_at: The lowest severity whose open finding refuses a push (and blocks a stop while the Stop hook is enabled). Operator order 2026-09-25: only high blocks at launch; raise to medium here.
$review_epoch: Commits authored before this instant are never reviewed, so a branch's older history is not back-reviewed on the day the hook landed. Author date, not committer date, so a rebase does not move old commits past it.
$retention_days: Review directories whose branch merged more than this many days ago are due for --prune-reviews. The one home of this number.
